AI To Video Generator — Initial Release

- Generate AI-powered 1080p MP4 videos from text prompts or scripts.
- Accepts TXT, DOCX, PDF, MP3 files up to 200MB for prompt input.
- Fast cloud-based rendering: results in 1–2 minutes per clip.
- Credits-based system with automatic anonymous token support (100 free credits, 7-day expiry).
- Includes session management, file upload, export, credits check, and state preview actions.
- Detailed error handling and workflow guidance included.
